core_principles: Authority meets Music: Combine the precision of legal tech software with the dark, focused aesthetic of a music producer's DAW (Digital Audio Workstation).
Single-Metric Focus: The plagiarism similarity score is the focal point. Everything else is secondary and supports this metric.
High Contrast for Legal Clarity: Use bright reds/ambers for warnings, strict white for text to ensure highly readable data.
design_philosophy.mood: Professional, authoritative, high-tech, secure, and cinematic.

headings.rules: Never use Inter for headings. Keep line height extremely tight (leading-none).

body.rules: Use for clear, legible body text and explanations of copyright laws.

data_and_code.usage: MANDATORY for similarity scores, percentages, timestamps, and legal threshold data to give a technical, precise feel.

text.contrast_rules: Always check contrast against #0A0A0E. Normal text min 4.5:1.

colors.rules: No pure black. Always tint backgrounds slightly. Use colored drop shadows for flagged waveform segments to make them pop.

marketing_page.grid: Tetris grid layout for feature highlights. Prioritize asymmetry and bold overlays.
marketing_page.hero: Max overlay bg-black/50 to let the background image breathe.

dashboard.grid: Control Room grid structure. Every pixel utilized.
dashboard.surfaces: 1px visible borders (border-white/10). No soft shadows, strictly 1px inner highlights for a technical look.

spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-md (subtle roundness, max 8px). Avoid fully rounded pills except for status badges.

components.buttons: Flat background with 1px border. On hover, translate-y-[-1px] with a sharp colored shadow.
components.cards: Marketing cards use 'Tracing Beam' effect. Dashboard widgets use strict 1px grid borders.
components.nav: Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 with 1px bottom border border-white/10. Sticky top with z-50.
components.visualizer: Use canvas or heavily stylized flex bars for waveforms. Segment colors match plagiarism status (Red for flagged, Blue/Green for safe).
components.forms: Heavily customized Shadcn inputs with dark backgrounds and high-focus ring contrast.

image_urls.description: Abstract sound wave background dark (Deep Blue)
High-end Music producer studio desk with monitors

media.icon_instructions: Use duotone weight for high-end look.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure HTML+Tailwind for the landing page layout to achieve asymmetry. Do not force Shadcn components into the hero section.
Use Shadcn UI for the dashboard, tables, and forms, deeply customizing them to match the dark archetype (remove defaults, use #121216 backgrounds).
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (kebab-case, role-based).
Never use pure black; use the provided #0A0A0E.
Plagiarism scores above the regional threshold must immediately draw the eye using the warning accent (#EF4444).
Use a dark, 'Control Room' grid for the scan results dashboard.
Implement explicit text colors on all hover states (e.g., hover:bg-white/10 hover:text-white).
